provenance.constantAcceleration: Closed-form Newtonian kinematics; no implementation output was used.
provenance.twoBodyCircular: Closed-form unit circular orbit with mu=1; expected values are evaluated independently from sin/cos at the declared nanosecond epoch.
provenance.figureEight: Published equal-mass figure-eight initial condition from Chenciner and Montgomery, Annals of Mathematics 152 (2000), scaled with G=1 for the reference fixture. The initial state is external reference data, not generated by OrbitEngine.

figureEight.referenceMethod: Published high-precision initial condition; future non-zero checkpoints must be generated by an independently configured arbitrary-precision integrator and recorded with its precision/order here.
